statusHistory.note: Batch 2026-09-07-batch-30, article 5/30: researched English draft. Sourced beyond Time Out per standing rule: The Arts Desk (indie classical-music press), The Ground Up substack (founder interview), Hackney Gazette, official site, Reddit. Current-status confirmed via Google Maps (4.5/529 reviews, dense Sept-Dec 2026 events listed, ticketed via Resident Advisor/Shotgun) and official What's On page. History: founded by Kwame Otiende and Aaron Edwards ~2.5 years after Passing Clouds (2006-2016, ~10,000 events) was forced to close by developers; building is the former Hackney Gazette printworks; Passing Clouds was an Asset of Community Value, which is why the developer entertained a speculative community bid at all. Noise-abatement dispute (2022-2023 era per multiple outlets, not current-2026) resolved via appeal/acoustics spend, mentioned as durable historical fact (survived a real threat), not framed as an ongoing crisis. Monday food bank (11am-4pm) is current per official site. No dated events used in body copy. Pending: five locale editions, full sign-offs, publish gates.
